messages.subject: Announcement: Distance web pages down
parts:
A number of people have contacted us to say that they are having trouble
accessing the distance web pages (http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/).
Our server is being upgraded and so service is likely to be unreliable for the
next few days. If you're having trouble I suggest you wait a week and try
again then.

- Len Thomas



--
